Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat

Class ContactAttack

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat.ContactAttack
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attack
Direct Known Subclasses:
AroundContactAttack, FrontContactAttack
public abstract class ContactAttack extends Object implements Attack
The attack of an enemy that hits at contact, such as a rat or a zombie (GDD 1.3.1): every hostile character whose hurtbox touches its area gets hit. It replaces the code of MeleeEnemy.attackTarget.

Pattern: Template Method. attack(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character, float, com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.World) always checks, starts the cooldown, hits and publishes the same way; each subclass only gives the area(com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry.Aabb, float) it covers.

    • attack

      public final void attack(Character owner, float aimDegrees, World world)
      Starts the owner's cooldown, then hits every hostile character whose hurtbox touches the area of this attack (see area(com.epitech.depthdiablo.geometry.Aabb, float)), never the owner itself. Each hit that lands publishes a DamageDealt event, and an EntityDied event if it kills.
      Specified by:
      attack in interface Attack
      Parameters:
      owner - the character who attacks; it must be able to attack now
      aimDegrees - the direction of the attack, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up); a finite number
      world - its entities are the targets, its event bus gets the damage and deaths
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if owner or world is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim is not a finite number
      IllegalStateException - if the owner cannot attack now (see Character.canAttack())

    • touches

      public final boolean touches(Aabb body, float aimDegrees, Aabb hurtbox)
      Tells whether the area of this attack, aimed from the body, touches the hurtbox. An enemy asks it before attacking, to know whether its target is in reach; attack(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character, float, com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.World) asks it for each character around.
      Parameters:
      body - the body box of the character who attacks
      aimDegrees - the direction of the attack, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      hurtbox - the hurtbox to reach
      Returns:
      true if an attack now would touch it
